# Agent movement corpora: combined timeline

<!-- Generated by tools/corpus_analysis.py; do not edit by hand. -->

**Data as of:** 2026-10-16 (latest `date_accessed` in the input records) · **Items:** 100 news ([source](../news-corpus/news.jsonl)) + 83 papers ([source](../paper-corpus/papers.jsonl))

Each line gives the publication date as stated by the source, the corpus ID (`AMN-` news, `AMP-` paper), a shortened title and the theme code. Papers dated only to a year or month are listed after the dated items of that period. Years 2024–2026 are broken down by month.

> **Read with care.** The timeline shows what the two corpora sampled, not how activity in the field was distributed over time. The news corpus is restricted to a fixed publication window and capped per theme; the paper corpus took a fixed number of candidates per theme and deliberately included seminal older work. Density differences between periods are therefore partly or wholly artefacts of the sampling protocol (see the corpus READMEs).
